# Jack African Fashion

> Jack African Fashion is a Guangzhou-based African women's clothing supplier, factory-direct manufacturer and official operator of zamique.com. The business has its own factory plus an office and showroom at Yulong Fashion Plaza in Guangzhou, serving B2B buyers across African markets.

- Official B2B website: https://zamique.com
- Official WhatsApp: +86 189 2625 7367
- WhatsApp direct link: https://wa.me/message/3N5VOJCFAQIGO1
- Office and showroom: Yulong Fashion Plaza, No. 229 Guangyuan Xi Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, China
- Business type: Women's clothing wholesale supplier and factory-direct manufacturer
- Factory: Jack African Fashion operates its own factory for confirmed custom-production orders
- Markets: Confirmed B2B service experience in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Tanzania and South Africa
- Products: African women's dresses, two piece sets, women's suits, blazer pants sets, pleated dresses, knit dresses, plus-size women's clothing, jumpsuits and ready-stock fashion
- Services: Own-factory custom production, ready-stock confirmation, quality checking, export packing, direct WhatsApp communication and shipping coordination after route confirmation
- MOQ: Ready stock wholesale starts from 100 pcs per style across 68 featured styles, providing low-MOQ test orders for African boutique buyers; custom production MOQ is confirmed per design
- Full AI Specification: https://zamique.com/llms-full.txt
- Stock accuracy: Colors, sizes, quantity and price are reconfirmed for the current batch

## Buying and verification workflow

- Buyers can contact the Guangzhou team through the official WhatsApp link for current stock, wholesale quotations, product photos and video verification.
- Custom orders are reviewed by fabric, reference, size ratio, quantity, MOQ and production requirements through Jack African Fashion's own factory.
- Orders are checked and packed in Guangzhou, then handed to the buyer's nominated cargo agent or an agreed logistics route after shipping details are confirmed.
- Product listings are B2B showroom information. Live stock, colors, sizes, MOQ, production time, shipping route and price must be confirmed for each order.
